segments.t: Down at the front desk, Qing and Manager Zhou wait anxiously by the cellar stairs until Chen climbs up wiping his hands on a rag and shaking his head. Listen first.
老陈，求你告诉我只是水管进了一点气！
坏消息。老热水器上的铜压力阀门裂了。
那今晚房间会冷吗？也没有热水了吗？
老砖墙保暖，房间到天亮都暖和，放心。
谢天谢地！那明天早上客人洗澡呢？
明天早上七点，洗澡水会冰凉。
冰凉的洗澡水？！成都旅游指南评审员就住在三楼啊！
工具箱里有备用的铜阀门吗？
冬天用掉最后一个了。只有桥那边的老五金店有这个尺寸。
那家五金店早上几点开门？
七点整——比早餐早半个小时。
定好闹钟吧，老陈。明早我们跑赢冷水！
Now let's go through the scene slowly, line by line.
坏消息。老热水器上的铜压力阀门裂了。
'Bad news. The brass pressure valve on the old water heater cracked.' Adding 'machine/appliance' onto 'hot-water' creates
热水器
the everyday household word for a water heater or boiler.
老砖墙保暖，房间到天亮都暖和，放心。
'Old brick walls hold heat, so the rooms stay warm until daybreak—don't worry.' Poetic word for dawn:
天亮
literally says 'sky turns bright', used naturally as 'daybreak'.
谢天谢地！那明天早上客人洗澡呢？
'Thank heavens! What about morning showers for the guests?' Dramatic sigh of relief:
谢天谢地
literally thanks heaven and thanks earth—exact match for 'thank heavens!'.
明天早上七点，洗澡水会冰凉。
'At seven tomorrow morning, the shower water will be ice-cold.' Repeating 'ice' onto 'cool' gives
冰凉
making 'cold' vivid enough to feel on your skin: 'ice-cold'.
工具箱里有备用的铜阀门吗？
'Is there a spare brass valve in your toolbox?' Practical compound
备用
joins 'prepare' with 'use' to describe a spare part kept in reserve.
冬天用掉最后一个了。只有桥那边的老五金店有这个尺寸。
'Used the last one in winter. Only the old hardware shop past the bridge carries this size.' Notice the shop name
五金店
literally 'five-metals shop', named after gold, silver, copper, iron, and tin.
那家五金店早上几点开门？
'What time does that hardware shop open in the morning?' Asking the clock hour uses
几点
literally 'how-many o'clock', right where the number seven will sit in the answer.
定好闹钟吧，老陈。明早我们跑赢冷水！
'Set your alarm, Chen. Tomorrow morning we outrun the cold water!' Putting 'win' onto 'run' builds
跑赢
turning 'outrun' or 'beat in a race' into one energetic compound. Now let's hear the whole conversation again from start to finish.
老陈，求你告诉我只是水管进了一点气！
坏消息。老热水器上的铜压力阀门裂了。
那今晚房间会冷吗？也没有热水了吗？
老砖墙保暖，房间到天亮都暖和，放心。
谢天谢地！那明天早上客人洗澡呢？
明天早上七点，洗澡水会冰凉。
冰凉的洗澡水？！成都旅游指南评审员就住在三楼啊！
工具箱里有备用的铜阀门吗？
冬天用掉最后一个了。只有桥那边的老五金店有这个尺寸。
那家五金店早上几点开门？
七点整——比早餐早半个小时。
定好闹钟吧，老陈。明早我们跑赢冷水！
A suspected travel-guide inspector on the third floor, a cracked brass valve in the cellar, and a seven o'clock race across the bridge at dawn. Episode 3 is complete; see you in Episode 4.
明天见！
